text:
aisha: Heads-up — bringing Cinder9B onto Dedicated for a first-pass onboarding/eval. After int3 quant the instruction-summarize suite shows a regression.
triage-bot: model cinder9b loaded on rig-12 gpu-2 (job 58210)
ben: what size/variant and which conversion pipeline did you use? can you paste the command?
aisha: cinder9b-rt variant. conversion: `python convert_ckpt.py --src llama --dst redwood --map-heads auto --phaseband true --tokenizer ./tokenizers/cinder_vocab.json`
chen: note: `--map-heads auto` will try to fold heads in twos when it detects legacy layout. that's experimental.
leo: curious — any signs in the kvcache or rotary angles? those usually bite long-context.
aisha: quick numbers: fp16 baseline rouge-l 37.8; int3 with `--map-heads per-head` => 36.6; int3 with `--map-heads auto` => 30.1. so big delta with the automatic mapping.
ben: ouch. can you paste any conversion warnings? errors?
aisha: small snippet: ```WARN: converter: mapping used: phaseband_v1
WARN: converter: token id fallback applied for 14 tokens
INFO: quantize: mean quantization error 0.0018
WARN: kvcache: prefix reindex detected (2 occurrences)``` 
leo: that `phaseband_v1` mapping is new — it remaps rotary angle groups, may wrap indices differently.
sanjay: microbench (local): fp16 latency 45ms @ seq512, int3 per-head 48ms, int3 phaseband 46ms but output quality tanked.
ben: sounds like not perf but semantic mismatch. my money is on token id shifts from tokenizer fallback + kvcache prefix reindex.
aisha: tokenizer run shows `offset +2` for multibyte glyphs (emojis, some CJK) because converter used legacy fallback mapping for out-of-vocab bytes.
chen: try disabling prefix caching to see whether kvcache reindex is the culprit: `--cache-prefix false`.
leo: also compute rotary angle diffs for a handful of heads: `np.max(np.abs(angles_h0 - angles_h1))` — if non-zero when it should be zero, mapping messed up.
aisha: running both now.
triage-bot: eval job 58213 queued (int3 per-head, cache-prefix false)
chen: if disabling cache fixes quality, then add a conversion sanity that verifies kv-index identity and token id parity across tokenizer mapping.
sanjay: FYI early results from job 58213: rouge-l 36.9 (much closer).
ben: OK that pins it to kvcache/prefix reindex. plan: add a unit test in converter that simulates a typical conversational prefix and ensures kv indices are identity-preserved for common tokenizer permutations.
leo: I'll open a PR with the test + docstring for `--map-heads` and deprecate `phaseband_v1` until we can prove parity.
aisha: will re-run full instruct eval with the fix applied, and if delta < 1.5 pts we can proceed with int3 rollout. otherwise fallback to per-head mapping in the model catalog.
sanjay: also propose an autorollback rule: if quality regression > 3 pts on the baseline eval set, block auto-deploy and alert Eng oncall.
aisha: thanks team — good triage. going to add the tokenizer parity check to the conversion script and run broad eval overnight. :white_check_mark:
